title: Resume sessions through the canonical persisted runtime-route resolver
before: At parent 7fd2f574132fcf8aea71ca485ca489c367fedffe, the Desktop/TUI resume adapter independently read provider, base_url, and api_mode only from top-level model_config fields, then fell back to billing_provider. Gateway turns persist the latest effective route under model_config.gateway_runtime, while billing_provider can remain fixed to the first accounted provider. Consequently, a resumed session could combine its current stored model with a stale provider or endpoint and fail at the provider interface.
after: At 33c6ab002d1fac653d7e772025ef7aaab7c83480, Desktop/TUI resume obtains provider, base_url, and api_mode from the same SessionDB.session_gateway_runtime resolver used by CLI resume. That resolver prioritizes a valid nested gateway_runtime route, otherwise retains top-level route metadata and fills only a missing provider from a routable billing_provider. Resume therefore restores the latest persisted route without discarding legacy top-level endpoint metadata.
diff: The change removes the TUI's hand-written provider-route extraction and delegates route resolution to the shared session-state reader. It adjusts the shared reader's fallback from an exclusive top-level-or-billing choice to a top-level route augmented with billing_provider only when provider is absent. Two regression tests cover nested runtime precedence over both a stale first-call billing provider and stale top-level route keys.

fix(core): keep the mirrored reasoning field off Fireworks requests (#11701)

Fireworks' OpenAI-compatible endpoint accepts the non-standard
reasoning_content field on input but rejects the additional reasoning
field with HTTP 400 (Extra inputs are not permitted, field:
'messages[N].reasoning'). The default provider mirrors
reasoning_content into reasoning for any model whose name contains
'qwen3' — a family match that does not establish the endpoint accepts
the extra field — so Qwen3 thinking models on Fireworks fail every
multi-turn continuation that replays a thinking turn, including
tool-call continuation (issue #11657).

Add a Fireworks provider, detected by api.fireworks.ai hostname in
determineProvider (following the Cerebras precedent from #11049), that
undoes the mirror at the outbound request boundary. Only the exact
mirror copy (reasoning === reasoning_content) is dropped; a distinct
explicit reasoning field and reasoning_content itself — which Fireworks
documents for reasoning replay — are preserved. Conversation history is
never mutated and non-Fireworks endpoints keep the existing mirroring.

title: Adapt heterogeneous provider errors into actionable HTTP failure messages
before: At parent 5d499272a879398985ad9b1695866ab3d8685053, provider catch paths generally used only Error.message or JSON.stringify(error). Consequently, gateway or proxy failures whose SDK objects retained the HTTP body in fields such as error.error or error.$response.body surfaced opaque text such as "403 status code (no body)" or "Unknown: UnknownError". Shared formatting then surfaces status plus body without duplicating an already-complete message. Eight text/image/response provider catch paths use the adapter; the Bedrock path retains its exception-category and data-retention behavior while selecting normalized body content, and the completions path avoids appending metadata already present in the normalized output.

episode.title: Adapt heterogeneous provider errors into actionable HTTP failure messages
episode.before: At parent 5d499272a879398985ad9b1695866ab3d8685053, provider catch paths generally used only Error.message or JSON.stringify(error). Consequently, gateway or proxy failures whose SDK objects retained the HTTP body in fields such as error.error or error.$response.body surfaced opaque text such as "403 status code (no body)" or "Unknown: UnknownError". Status-prefixed response adapters preserved status but still omitted separately stored response bodies.
episode.after: At merge commit 6fbeba51af98a37a0695ec8b53308dde81d9ab46, a shared adapter extracts status and body data from several SDK error shapes, safely serializes non-Error throws, rejects empty bodies, caps body text at 4000 characters, and records whether the existing message already contains the body. Shared formatting then surfaces status plus body without duplicating an already-complete message. Eight text/image/response provider catch paths use the adapter; the Bedrock path retains its exception-category and data-retention behavior while selecting normalized body content, and the completions path avoids appending metadata already present in the normalized output.
episode.diff: Relative to first parent 5d499272a879398985ad9b1695866ab3d8685053, the implementation adds packages/ai/src/utils/error-body.ts, updates eight provider adapters, and adds three test files. The merge reports 580 insertions and 36 deletions across 12 files. The core change replaces message-only error handling with normalization and formatting of SDK-specific status/body fields, adds bounded and duplicate-aware output behavior, and exercises helper-level edge cases plus real catch paths for image generation, completions, responses, and Bedrock streaming.

evidence_units.claim: The shared normalizer maps SDK-specific status fields statusCode, status, $metadata.httpStatusCode, and $response.statusCode into one optional numeric status, and maps body, non-empty error objects, and $response.body into one body string.

Normalization safely serializes non-Error throws, trims and rejects empty body text, truncates retained bodies to 4000 characters, and marks when the original message already contains the extracted body.

The formatter preserves the original message when it already carries the body or when status/body data is incomplete; otherwise it emits status and body, optionally retaining a provider-specific prefix.

Before the change, the response adapters formatted Error.message and optional status directly, while the other affected catch paths assigned Error.message or JSON.stringify(error); none consulted parsed or raw SDK body fields.
